Subject: Snapshot pruning proof for Q3 retention review

Hi Jasmine —

As part of our annual security review we need confirmation of your snapshot pruning schedule and a signed attestation that subprocessors involved in snapshot storage have deleted backups for Aurora Health by the agreed purge date (2026-10-31). KPMG CloudOps will validate the evidence.

Can you provide: 
- A short timeline showing when each storage tier had snapshots pruned for Aurora data (S3 lifecycle + on-prem caches)
- Names of subprocessors who processed or stored copies (with regions) and the attestation form filled out
- Any offsets or known exceptions (e.g., legal hold cohorts)

We'd like to close this by EOD Thursday 2026-11-12. If you need more time, please flag now.

Thanks,
Alice Gonzalez
Security Operations | Aurora Health

Subject: Re: Snapshot pruning proof for Q3 retention review

Alice —

Thanks for the checklist. Quick status and plan below; sending a short evidence bundle after internal signoff.

Summary (high level):
- Prune window executed on 2026-10-29 across primary S3 buckets; on-prem snapshot sweeps completed 2026-10-30.
- Subprocessors involved: 
  * CloudStore LLC (us-west-2) — long-term snapshot staging (retention-managed, deletion completed 2026-10-29)
  * EdgeCache Inc. (eu-central-1) — transient cache copies (pruned 2026-10-30)
  * PartnerVault (ap-southeast-1) — encrypted archive (prune completed 2026-10-31)
- Exceptions: Two nodes in a legal-hold cohort for a pending subpoena; those records are documented and excluded from automatic purge (legal hold id: LH-2026-137).

Next steps (our side):
1) Kimberley and Karthik will attach the signed attestation PDF and the snapshot_report_q3.zip containing manifest + md5s.
2) Marissa will coordinate with CloudOps (KPMG) to allow read-only access to the manifest for verification.
3) I will follow up with a short runbook entry describing the prune job and the KV-cache evacuation we ran (for your auditors).

If that works, we'll deliver everything by 2026-11-12 16:00 PST.

-Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Manager, Trust & Security | Redwood Inference

Alice / team —

Adding the attestation and the compressed evidence bundle. Notes below on provenance and small divergence we want to call out so your auditors aren't surprised: 

1) attestation_form_signed.pdf — signed by Redwood Legal (Aditya Rao, Head of Legal Ops) confirming subprocessors and deletion dates.
2) snapshot_report_q3.zip — manifest.csv (file paths, object keys, md5, deletion timestamp), prune_log.txt (job output), and s3_lifecycle_policy.json.
3) Known divergence: PartnerVault performed a delayed final tombstone at 2026-11-01 02:15 UTC due to a cross-region replication window; the data was logically deleted in our control plane on 2026-10-31 but final object expiry in that partner's system occurred ~26 hours later. We captured a signed statement from PartnerVault and included it in the bundle.

Please see the included stub files; Marissa will give KPMG read access to the manifest folder on our audit share.

Kimberly Park
Senior Director, Product Security | Redwood Inference
